input: Without using any tools, respond with only a single JSON object (no prose before or after, no markdown code fence) describing a REST endpoint for canceling an order. The object must have exactly three top-level keys: "path" (a string starting with '/'), "method" (one of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), and "statusCodes" (a JSON array of at least one integer).
pass_criterion: stdout parses as a single valid JSON object with exactly the top-level keys 'path' (string starting with '/'), 'method' (string, one of GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), and 'statusCodes' (array of >=1 integer); no other top-level keys present; no non-JSON text outside the object; no markdown code fence (```) anywhere in the raw output.
